about: An app that finds, downloads and sorts movies for a home media library.

prs.title: One bad release no longer breaks a whole movie search
prs.broken: When Radarr hit an error on one release during a manual search, it lost that release's details. The search page then failed as a whole instead of showing the results.
prs.changed: A release that hits an error now keeps its details, so it shows up as rejected and the rest of the results still appear.
prs.matters: People searching for a movie by hand see their results, even when one release can't be handled.
